NEBNext® Ultra™ DNA Library Prep Protocol for Illumina® With Size Selection (E7370)
Mix the following components in a sterile nuclease-free tube (Total volume 65 μl): End Prep Enzyme Mix   3.0 μl; End Repair Reaction Buffer (10X) 6.5 μl; Fragmented DNA   55.5 μl.
Mix by pipetting.
Quick spin to collect all liquid from the sides of the tube.
Place in a thermocycler, with the heated lid on, and run the following program:TimeTemperature30 minutes20°C30 minutes65°CHold4°C.
Add the following components directly to the End Prep reaction mixture and mix well (Total volume 83.5 μl): Blunt/TA Ligase Master Mix   15 μl; NEBNext Adaptor for Illumina   2.5 μl; Ligation Enhancer   1 μl.
Mix by pipetting.
Quick spin to collect all liquid from the sides of the tube.
Incubate at 20°C for 15 minutes in a thermal cycler.
Add 3 μl of USER™ enzyme to the ligation mixture from step 8.
Mix well and incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Vortex AMPure XP beads to resuspend.
Add 13.5 μl dH2O to the ligation reaction for a 100 μl total volume.
Add 55 μl of resuspended AMPure XP beads to the 100 μl ligation reaction.
Mix well by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quickly spin the tube.
Place the tube on an appropriate magnetic stand to separate the beads from the supernatant.
After the solution is clear (about 5 minutes), carefully transfer the supernatant containing your DNA to a new tube (Caution: do not discard the supernatant).
Discard the beads that contain the unwanted large fragments.
Add 25 μl resuspended AMPure XP beads to the supernatant.
Mix well and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quickly spin the tube.
Place it on an appropriate magnetic stand to separate the beads from the supernatant.
After the solution is clear (about 5 minutes), carefully remove and discard the supernatant that contains unwanted DNA.
Be careful not to disturb the beads that contain the desired DNA targets (Caution: do not discard beads).
Wash #1: Add 200 μl of 80% freshly prepared ethanol to the tube while in the magnetic stand.
Wash #1: Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Wash #1: Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash #2: Add 200 μl of 80% freshly prepared ethanol to the tube while in the magnetic stand.
Wash #2: Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Wash #2: Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash #3: Add 200 μl of 80% freshly prepared ethanol to the tube while in the magnetic stand.
Wash #3: Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Wash #3: Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Air the dry beads for 10 minutes while the tube is on the magnetic stand with the lid open.
Elute the DNA target from the beads into 28 μl of 10 mM Tris-HCl or 0.1 X TE, pH 8.0.
Mix well on a vortex mixer or by pipetting up and down.
Quickly spin the tube and place it on a magnetic stand.
After the solution is clear (about 5 minutes), transfer 23 μl to a new PCR tube for amplification.
Mix the following components in sterile strip tubes (Total volume   50 μl): Adaptor Ligated DNA Fragments   23 μl; NEBNext High Fidelity 2X PCR Master Mix   25 μl; Index Primer   1 μl; Universal PCR Primer  1 μl.
PCR using the following cycling conditions: CYCLE STEPTEMPTIMECYCLESInitial Denaturation98°C30 seconds1Denaturation98°C10 seconds6-15*Annealing65°C30 secondsExtension72°C30 secondsFinal Extension72°C5 minutes1Hold4°C∞.
Vortex AMPure XP beads to resuspend.
Add 50 μl of resuspended AMPure XP beads to the PCR reactions (~ 50 μ l).
Mix well by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Quickly spin the tube and place it on an appropriate magnetic stand to separate beads from supernatant.
After the solution is clear (about 5 minutes), carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Be careful not to disturb the beads that contain DNA targets (Caution do not discard beads).
Wash #1: Add 200 μl of 80% ethanol to the PCR plate while in the magnetic stand.
Wash #1:  Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Wash #1: Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Wash #2: Add 200 μl of 80% ethanol to the PCR plate while in the magnetic stand.
Wash #2:  Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Wash #2: Carefully remove and discard the supernatant.
Air dry the beads for 10 minutes while the PCR plate is on the magnetic stand with the lid open.
Elute DNA target from beads into 33 μl 10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0 or 0.1X TE.
Mix well by pipetting up and down at least 10 times.
Quickly spin the tube and place it on an appropriate magnetic stand to separate beads from supernatant.
After the solution is clear (about 5 minutes), carefully transfer 28 μl supernatant to a new PCR tube.
Dilute the library 5 fold with water, and check the size distribution on an Agilent high sensitivity chip.

# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
mix(container='sterile nuclease-free tube', reagent={'End Prep Enzyme Mix': '3.0 μl', 'End Repair Reaction Buffer (10X)': '6.5 μl', 'Fragmented DNA': '55.5 μl'}, volume='65 μl')
mix(container='sterile nuclease-free tube', speed='pipetting')
centrifuge(container='sterile nuclease-free tube', duration='quick spin')
incubate(container='sterile nuclease-free tube', temperature=['20°C', '65°C', '4°C'], duration=['30 minutes', '30 minutes', 'hold'], instrument='thermocycler', heated lid=True)
add(container='sterile nuclease-free tube', reagent={'Blunt/TA Ligase Master Mix': '15 μl', 'NEBNext Adaptor for Illumina': '2.5 μl', 'Ligation Enhancer': '1 μl'}, volume='83.5 μl', to='End Prep reaction mixture')
mix(container='sterile nuclease-free tube', speed='pipetting')
centrifuge(container='sterile nuclease-free tube', duration='quick spin')
incubate(container='sterile nuclease-free tube', temperature='20°C', duration='15 minutes', instrument='thermal cycler')
add(container='sterile nuclease-free tube', reagent={'USER enzyme': '3 μl'}, to='ligation mixture from step 8')
mix(container='sterile nuclease-free tube')
incubate(container='sterile nuclease-free tube', temperature='37°C', duration='15 minutes')
mix(container='AMPure XP beads vial', reagent='AMPure XP beads', speed='vortex', purpose='resuspend')
add(container='ligation reaction', reagent='dH2O', volume='13.5 μl', final volume='100 μl')
add(container='100 μl ligation reaction', reagent='resuspended AMPure XP beads', volume='55 μl')
mix(container='ligation reaction', speed='pipetting up and down at least 10 times')
incubate(container='ligation reaction', temperature='room temperature', duration='5 minutes')
centrifuge(container='ligation reaction tube', duration='quick spin')
separate(container='ligation reaction tube', instrument='magnetic stand', purpose='separate beads from supernatant')
wait(container='ligation reaction tube', duration='5 minutes', purpose='solution to clear')
transfer(container='ligation reaction tube', reagent='supernatant containing DNA', to='new tube')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: discard (container: ligation reaction tube, reagent: beads containing unwanted large fragments, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
add(container='new tube (supernatant)', reagent='resuspended AMPure XP beads', volume='25 μl')
mix(container='new tube (supernatant + beads)')
incubate(container='new tube (supernatant + beads)', temperature='room temperature', duration='5 minutes')
centrifuge(container='new tube (supernatant + beads)', duration='quick spin')
separate(container='new tube (supernatant + beads)', instrument='magnetic stand', purpose='separate beads from supernatant')
wait(container='new tube (supernatant + beads)', duration='5 minutes', purpose='solution to clear')
remove(container='new tube (supernatant + beads)', reagent='supernatant containing unwanted DNA', purpose='discard')
wash(container='tube on magnetic stand', reagent='80% freshly prepared ethanol', volume='200 μl', wash_number=1)
incubate(container='tube on magnetic stand', temperature='room temperature', duration='30 seconds', wash_number=1)
remove(container='tube on magnetic stand', reagent='supernatant', wash_number=1, purpose='discard')
wash(container='tube on magnetic stand', reagent='80% freshly prepared ethanol', volume='200 μl', wash_number=2)
incubate(container='tube on magnetic stand', temperature='room temperature', duration='30 seconds', wash_number=2)
remove(container='tube on magnetic stand', reagent='supernatant', wash_number=2, purpose='discard')
wash(container='tube on magnetic stand', reagent='80% freshly prepared ethanol', volume='200 μl', wash_number=3)
incubate(container='tube on magnetic stand', temperature='room temperature', duration='30 seconds', wash_number=3)
remove(container='tube on magnetic stand', reagent='supernatant', wash_number=3, purpose='discard')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: dry (container: tube on magnetic stand, reagent: beads, duration: 10 minutes, other: {'lid': 'open'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
elute(container='tube on magnetic stand', reagent='10 mM Tris-HCl or 0.1 X TE, pH 8.0', volume='28 μl', from='beads')
mix(container='tube on magnetic stand', speed='vortex or pipetting up and down')
centrifuge(container='tube', duration='quick spin')
separate(container='tube', instrument='magnetic stand')
wait(container='tube', duration='5 minutes', purpose='solution to clear')
transfer(container='tube', reagent='23 μl eluted DNA', volume='23 μl', to='new PCR tube')
mix(container='sterile strip tubes', reagent={'Adaptor Ligated DNA Fragments': '23 μl', 'NEBNext High Fidelity 2X PCR Master Mix': '25 μl', 'Index Primer': '1 μl', 'Universal PCR Primer': '1 μl'}, volume='50 μl')
amplify(container='PCR tube', volume='50 μl', temperature=['98°C', '65°C', '72°C', '4°C'], duration=['30 seconds', '10 seconds', '30 seconds', '30 seconds', '5 minutes', 'hold'], cycles='6-15', instrument='thermocycler')
mix(container='AMPure XP beads vial', reagent='AMPure XP beads', speed='vortex', purpose='resuspend')
add(container='PCR reactions (~50 μl)', reagent='resuspended AMPure XP beads', volume='50 μl')
mix(container='PCR reactions', speed='pipetting up and down at least 10 times')
incubate(container='PCR reactions', temperature='room temperature', duration='5 minutes')
centrifuge(container='PCR reactions tube', duration='quick spin')
separate(container='PCR reactions tube', instrument='magnetic stand')
wait(container='PCR reactions tube', duration='5 minutes', purpose='solution to clear')
remove(container='PCR reactions tube', reagent='supernatant', purpose='discard')
wash(container='PCR plate on magnetic stand', reagent='80% ethanol', volume='200 μl', wash_number=1)
incubate(container='PCR plate on magnetic stand', temperature='room temperature', duration='30 seconds', wash_number=1)
remove(container='PCR plate on magnetic stand', reagent='supernatant', wash_number=1, purpose='discard')
wash(container='PCR plate on magnetic stand', reagent='80% ethanol', volume='200 μl', wash_number=2)
incubate(container='PCR plate on magnetic stand', temperature='room temperature', duration='30 seconds', wash_number=2)
remove(container='PCR plate on magnetic stand', reagent='supernatant', wash_number=2, purpose='discard')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: dry (container: PCR plate on magnetic stand, reagent: beads, duration: 10 minutes, other: {'lid': 'open'})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
elute(container='PCR plate on magnetic stand', reagent='10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0 or 0.1X TE', volume='33 μl', from='beads')
mix(container='PCR plate on magnetic stand', speed='pipetting up and down at least 10 times')
centrifuge(container='tube', duration='quick spin')
separate(container='tube', instrument='magnetic stand')
wait(container='tube', duration='5 minutes', purpose='solution to clear')
transfer(container='tube', reagent='28 μl supernatant', volume='28 μl', to='new PCR tube')
dilute(container='library tube', reagent='water', volume='5 fold')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: check (container: Agilent high sensitivity chip, reagent: library, other: {'purpose': 'size distribution'})
